JOIN OUR CSA

Our CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) share allows you to enjoy the most nutritionally dense and delicious local food, invest in Kiss the Cow Farm, and strengthen your agricultural community. Kiss the Cow Farm’s CSA program directly supports our farm as well as other small, local, Vermont farms and food processors.
CSA members enjoy a personal relationship with their farmers, and a special involvement in our farm’s growing season. When you sign up for CSA, you share in the benefits of bountiful harvests, and you also help ensure financial stability for your area farmers. By paying for the membership up front, CSA members help us get the next batch of chicks, or the next shipment of feed, allowing us to offer more locally-made food products, and make it possible for us to afford the labor and equipment required to run a small farm.

Fresh Milk from Kiss the Cow Farm
Exciting news from the farm:
We now offer both raw AND pasteurized milk!
Kiss the Cow Farm is one of only a handful of farms across the country that currently offers 100% organic, 100% grass-fed, 100% A2/A2 milk. It's available raw or "minimally pasteurized," and is as local as it comes. These attributes are unique and practically not available elsewhere. Stop by and pick up a half gallon of our delicious milk. It doesn't get any better than this!
	
Our milk is…
A2/A2  (What is A2/A2 milk?)
100% grass-fed
Certified organic  (by Vermont Organic Farmers)
Fresh, creamline, whole milk
Available raw or pasteurized
Non-homogenized
Grain and soybean-free
FREE from pesticides, herbicides, fungicides, hormones, antibiotics, preservatives, GMO’s, animal by-products, animal protein products, or other additives
From pampered Jersey and Normande cows, who are outside in the fresh air and sunshine expressing their cowness

"Because supermarket milk sucks - Sue, long time KTC milk customer

"For the record book of WOW’S that you must receive constantly: I had a glass of milk with breakfast and the lovely richness, everything about it gave us instant relief from the [pandemic chaos] happening everywhere!
Truly a full experience panacea. Gratefully & gluggingly yours - Mary

"Poured a glass of your milk to finish up breakfast. OMG! Your milk is the nectar of the gods - divine. Grateful for truly the world's best drink! -another long time KTC milk groupie

"[Kiss the Cow Farm] milk is the fanciest I have ever had." - Susan

" Kiss the Cow Farm makes the best milk I've ever tasted. How they take care of their cows comes through in the product....I'm so grateful" - CSA member

About Kiss the Cow Farm
​Kiss the Cow Farm, located in Barnard, VT, is an organic, grass-based dairy selling raw and pasteurized A2/A2 milk as well as ice cream from our small herd of Jersey and Normande cows.  We also raise organic layer chickens and flowers. We sell our products through a farm store, seasonal CSAs, weekly farmers' markets and area co-ops. 

Kiss the Cow Farm is owned and run by Randy and Lisa Robar. For the past several years we have been growing a dynamic, small, diversified farm operation focused on feeding our friends and neighbors delicious food.

Both Randy and Lisa work (more than) full-time on the farm. We host WWOOFers and interns throughout the season to help with chores and other work, which allows us to train a new generation of farmers. 
​
Since beginning working on this farm, we have invested in soil improvements through nutrient amendments, intensive grazing, and clipping.  We’ve also added additional infrastructure to the farm, including two greenhouses, a poultry processing shed, and additional equipment (waterlines, frost-free hydrants, high-tensile and single-strand fencing,  and more). We also have a heated milk house, an ever-growing farm store, and a passion for welcoming our neighbors onto our farm. 
To read more about how the farm got started, read Randy's story here.
	
Lisa & Randy

Become a Member of Our Free-Choice, Whole-Diet, Locally-Grown CSA
Our Whole Diet CSA features over 350 local products from more than one hundred local farmers and food producers. 

And of course, you'll get easy access to Kiss the Cow's raw and pasteurized milk, delicious ice cream and organic eggs. 

Dairy, vegetables, meat, pantry staples, health & beauty aids and more. We add new products all the time. 

For a limited time, sign up and SAVE 10% on groceries! (an additional 10% will be added to your balance after sign up)

By signing up, you'll enjoy these local foods every week, plus we'll deliver! We’ll send you an email prompting you to order for each week.  Select online what you'd like and it'll all get bagged and will be ready for you to pick up at your location. Order only the products you want; pay only for those items. Think of our CSA as a debit system: each purchase is deducted from your balance. Easy peazy!

The CSA is flexible to your needs – if you're going away for the week,  don’t order anything.  Having some friends over? Order extra!  You receive only the food you want on the weeks you want it.  Easily order, track your purchases and balance.  Multiple payment options are available . More easy peazy!

Cash, checks, credit cards and first-borns all accepted. Either in full or a monthly payment plan. (Okay, maybe not first-borns, that would be a debit, not a credit)! Share costs are automatically prorated each week so you can join at any time! Special discounts for low income families may be available thanks to the generosity of our neighbors. 

Please note, there is a one-time bagging and delivery fee of $55 to help us cover these costs. (This fee is does not apply if you choose to pick up your Shares at the Farm Store). 

We gladly accept credit cards (subject to 3% transaction fee), e-checks and paper checks.

NOFA-VT Farm Share Program
We've partnered with NOFA-VT to make local food accessible to low-income families throughout our community. 

NOFA-VT will match donations made from other Kiss the Cow Farm CSA members to allow us to offer CSA shares at 50% off to income-eligible Vermonters. 

You can find out more or apply for the Farm Share Program at NOFA-VT. 

Would You Like to Help Feed Your Neighbors?
Then please consider becoming a volunteer driver. (And receive a Farm Store discount)! Delivering food bags to the pickup locations is a safe way to make a real difference in peoples' lives. ​​

Whole Diet CSA: Frequently Asked Questions
Potential Member FAQs 
(Please note - Current Member FAQs are lower down on the page)

How Does the Whole Diet CSA Work?
Members sign up for a CSA (community supported agriculture) membership with a flat fee payable in a single payment or multiple installments. In exchange, you will receive your choice of dozens of locally produced dairy, meat, poultry, vegetable, bakery, shelf-stable and health & beauty products. You place your order through our convenient online store each week to select only the products you want. We will bag and deliver them to a pickup location of your choice.

How Much Does It Cost?
There are a variety of share sizes available for our Whole Diet Winter CSA, from $395 to $895 (an average of $19 to $43 each week). 

How Do I Sign Up?!
It’s easy! Click Here to Sign Up. Membership spots will be filled on a first come, first served basis.
 
What Produce is Available?
We offer over 40 varieties, including fresh greens and other vegetables as they become available. And we carry all standard varieties of root and locally available fresh vegetables during the cold months. We source veggies from multiple, small, local farmers to maximize varieties, early availability and quantities. 
 
Are Your Products Organic?
Kiss the Cow Farm is certified organic, and so are some of our partner farms and producers.  However, not all food items are organic. 

Can I Really Order Only What I Want?
Yes! However, we reserve the right to restrict quantities on specific items if availability is limited. In order to allow us time to prepare your specific items, orders need to be placed by noon the day before your pick-up.

May We Visit the Farm?
Absolutely!  Please come and visit us! The only way you can ever really know where and how your food is raised is to see for yourselves.  (Besides, the calves are very cute).

Which Size Share Should I Get?
If you are new to the CSA, we recommend getting the small share. The majority of our customers choose this size. However, if you are feeding a family or love local food, we recommend a larger share. You can always add more money to your account later if you want.

Can I Send Someone Else to Pick Up My Stuff If I Can't Be There?
Sure! (If you trust them not to eat your goodies!)

Where Do I Send Payment?
You can pay by credit card (subject to 3% transaction fee) or eCheck when you register online, or you can send us an old fashioned paper check (Made out to Kiss the Cow Farm) to:

     992 Walker Hill Road
     South Royalton, VT 05068

How Do You Communicate With Us?
Email is our primary method of communication for the CSA. You can always reach us at farmers@kissthecowfarm.com

Are There Any Benefits to Picking Up at the Farm Store?
Yes. If you live nearby it may simply be more convenient. Also, there is no bagging and delivery fee if you pick up at the Farm Store. The Farm Store also has food and goodies that may not be available for remote pick ups. And of course, you get to chat with the farmers or if you don't want to talk with them you can see the cows! 

Can I Add Money To My Account Later On?
Of course! You can add any amount at any time. 

What If I Don't See an Item Available That I Want?
It may mean that we've run out of a particular product. If you'd like us to carry a particular product, send us a note and we will try to accommodate your wishes.  

How Do I Know My Account Balance?
You can see your balance anytime online by logging into your CSA account.  (Note: farm store pickups will keep track of your own account balances).  

I'm Not Going to be Around During the Holidays. Is My Account Still Charged?
Nope. You are only charged for the items you order. Ours is a very flexible program. If you're going to be away, simply don't order anything that week. No problem at all.

How Do I Pick Up My Share? 
It's as easy as pie. Show up during the appointed time on the day of the pick-up! We'll have your goodies all bagged and ready for you. Please note that many products require refrigeration or need to be kept frozen.

If you elect to pick up your food from the Farm Store, you may stop in anytime, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. You'll write down the items you get on your personal CSA purchase page in the 3-ring binder at the checkout table. 

I Don't Want to Be Near Other People When I Pick Up. Is This Possible? 
Yes. We will space out everyone's bags (hopefully in the shade!) at the pickup locations. You will NOT need to interact with anyone else while picking up your food. 

If I Cannot Make a Pick Up, What Are My Options?
You can either wait until the following week or stop by our adorable Farm Store (in Barnard) to get your items. In the Farm Store's check out binder, simply write your name, the items you're getting, the total, and that you're a CSA member. We'll add this to your account.  

What If I Miss a Pick Up?
We recognize that we all forget sometimes or something unexpected crops up. Everyone gets a one-time grace. Additional missed pick-ups will be brought back to the farm and you will be charged a $25 restocking fee.  

Can I Join After the CSA Has Already Started?
Yes -if we still have room. (We really do only have a limited number of memberships based on the amount of food we have available and logistical considerations). The share price is automatically pro-rated each week.  

Does Kiss the Cow Farm Produce All This Food?
Goodness, no! Our focus is on dairy, vegetables and pastured poultry. The rest of the products come from dozens of local farms and small producers. (Click here to see a sample list). 

In Case of Inclement Weather on Pick Up Day, What Do I Do?
We'll send you an email to let you know if we are unable to deliver (due to snow, ice or other) and give you a rescheduled time, if possible.
SIGN ME UP FOR THE CSA!
Current Member FAQs

​How Do I Order?
Members have access to place custom orders via our convenient online store.  When certain products are in high demand or are available in limited quantities, we may impose a maximum order quantity until supplies are replenished.

CLICK THE LINK BELOW for our handy-dandy how-to doc that explains the ordering process in delightful detail:

csa_how-to.pdf
Download File
Can I Change My Pickup Location?
Of course!  You'll have the option to select your pick-up location every time you place an order.  Want to pick up this week in Woodstock, but next week at the Farm Store in Barnard?  You got it!  Just another way our membership program is customized for you and easy to use.

Is There a Minimum Order I must Place Each Time?
No. Order only what you want.
 
When Does My Membership Expire?
Your membership expires when your current CSA membership season ends. 

How Do I Renew My Membership?
We'll send you email notices about upcoming CSA seasons.
 
What Happens If I Don't Use Up All My Available Credit?
You are responsible for using any available credits by the end of the delivery season. Credit cannot be carried over to the next season. No refunds are available. However, given all the tempting food choices you probably won’t have this issue!

What Happens When I Go on Vacation? 
Nothing. Go have fun!

What Happens If I Move?
We’ll miss you! We will terminate your account on your moving date and no further payments will be charged to your account. No refunds will be issued due to a move

How Do I Cancel My Membership?
What? Are you crazy? If you decide that a Kiss the Cow Farm membership is not for you, simply tell us. No further payments will be charged to your account. Because the membership program is made sustainable by the total annual membership fees, we cannot offer mid-season refunds.

Is Meat Included in My Membership?
Yup. We offer Eastman Farm ground and steaks; hotdogs, sausages and pork from Rebop Farm.  Plus local lamb, when available, and even Vermont salmon (ask and we'll tell you the story!). Of course Kiss the Cow chicken is available too.
 
Are Eggs Included in My Membership?
Yes. We offer our own organic eggs, plus eggs from area farms.

Whole Diet CSA:  Policies
Before joining our CSA, we ask that our members read and commit to the following statements. These policies are what keep our CSA running smoothly, both for our members and for our farm team.

I understand that I am committing to the seasonality of the CSA model, which affects product availability, and will respect the parameters of being a CSA shareholder.
I understand that the farmers and producers will do their best to provide a season's worth of fresh and frozen foods and value-added goods.
I understand that I am sharing in the risks and challenges inherent to farming and that quantities and availability of products may change throughout the season.
I understand that, to the best of Kiss the Cow Farm’s knowledge, all CSA's products are produced sustainably, locally, and ethically, and some are certified organic.
I understand that it is my responsibility to pick up my share at the designated time and location.
I understand that for Home Delivery someone needs to be at home to accept the delivery or a cooler with ice should be placed in an accessible location for Kiss the Cow Farm to place my bag(s) in. 
I understand that for Home Delivery, Kiss the Cow Farm is not responsible for the condition of my items after they have been delivered.
I understand that Kiss the Cow Farm may deny my Home Delivery location if it is deemed too far or too inaccessible. 
I understand that after a one-time grace, a $25 restocking fee may be charged to my account for each additional missed pickup.
I understand that email is the primary method of communication with the farm, and I agree to open and read emails from the farm.
I understand that there is a one-time bagging and delivery fee of $55 (not applicable if you pick up at the Farm Store).
I understand that the success of the CSA and Kiss the Cow Farm depends on my continued commitment to support the farm throughout the delivery season. Due to this, I understand that no refunds will be provided for any remaining share balance at the end of the season.
BECOME A MEMBER!
